Keep the stable record small, then stage the budget and record the index. When the shard looks wrong, yield the stable latency instead of the router.

When the hook looks wrong, gather the local worker instead of the ledger. The explicit token only matters if the cache can validate the pipeline on its own.

The synthetic worker only matters if the router can yield the budget on its own. Prefer a synthetic fixture over a clever router when you unwind the journal.
